visualCharacteristics.purpose: page-bottom legal and trademark disclosures in small print, with an optional brand logo on the left and social icon links on the right

contentPattern.structure: one row; cells for an optional logo (image only), the disclosure copy (paragraphs with inline links), and an optional set of icon links (social media). A cell holding only a /fragments/ link is replaced by that fragment, so shared disclosures can be authored once

usage: Use at the foot of product pages (e.g. Apple Pay / Google Pay / Samsung Pay) for eligibility notes, trademark statements and copyright.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any small-print disclosure area. Short footnote toggles belong in disclosure-links; site-wide legal link rows in legal-links.
